format: Captioned sequence of real application screen captures; no audio or continuous pointer recording.

scenes.title: Organiser home
scenes.caption: Mary Ng starts a team order. Each participant pays for their own items.

scenes.title: Group setup
scenes.caption: Name the group and choose an expected capacity between two and ten.

scenes.title: Advance collection
scenes.caption: Advance choices reserve at least two hours after the planned ordering deadline.

scenes.title: Ordering time and payment
scenes.caption: Thirty minutes to order. Every person confirms their own saved card; no charge happens yet.

scenes.title: Pending invitations
scenes.caption: Ben and Calvin are invited, but the joined-member count remains one until they accept.

scenes.title: Joining notice and consent
scenes.caption: Ben reads the disclosure. Marketing consent is separate and starts unticked; joining does not require it.

scenes.title: Menu and personal choices
scenes.caption: The menu contains food pictures, categories, current prices and customisable set drinks.

scenes.title: Customise an item
scenes.caption: Choose the set drink, sweetness and quantity. Supplements are included in the total.

scenes.title: Personal reward and points
scenes.caption: Ben redeems 200 points for two dollars off: he pays $4.30 and estimates 37 advance points.

scenes.title: Personal saved cards
scenes.caption: Ben confirms his own card. Card selection does not charge it; charging waits for a successful send.

scenes.title: Individual customisation
scenes.caption: Mary selects less sweet without changing the default set price. Each person edits only their own cart.

scenes.title: Organiser review
scenes.caption: Mary reviews three submitted orders and personal payment readiness. The group total is $16.90.

scenes.title: Decline blocks sending
scenes.caption: Ben card is declined. The order stays unsent and nobody is charged; Mary sees status without his card details.

scenes.title: Payment status privacy
scenes.caption: Calvin sees his own payment readiness. Ben named failure and card details are absent from this view.

scenes.title: Recover with another card
scenes.caption: Ben default card ending 2222 is unavailable for this order. He confirms the alternative ending 8018.

scenes.title: Consolidated outlet order
scenes.caption: One outlet order combines three sets and preserves each selected drink and sweetness option.

scenes.title: Who gets what
scenes.caption: The post-send breakdown lists the items belonging to Mary, Ben and Calvin.

scenes.title: Ready notification and pending points
scenes.caption: The outlet-ready notification appears. Points remain pending until Mary confirms collection.

scenes.title: Personal points credited
scenes.caption: Collection credits 55 points to Mary, 37 to Ben and 55 to Calvin, once only.

scenes.title: Correct personal receipt
scenes.caption: Ben was charged $4.30 on his alternative card ending 8018, and received his own points.

scenes.title: History preserves the award
scenes.caption: History retains Ben payment, selected card, 10 percent bonus and 37-point award.

scenes.title: Review optional consent
scenes.caption: Calvin previously chose marketing opt-in. His preference is separate from other accounts and from joining.

scenes.title: Withdraw optional consent
scenes.caption: Calvin can withdraw his own preference. No marketing messages are actually sent by this demo.

scenes.title: Seven-day retention
scenes.caption: Completed history and saved groups expire after seven inactive days. Leaving only clears related active data and membership.

scenes.title: Scoped expiry demonstration
scenes.caption: One inactive history example and one owned saved group expire. Other records and the recent completed group remain.

scenes.title: Reuse a saved group
scenes.caption: Mary reuses the saved team. Ben and Calvin receive invitations again; only Mary has joined so far.

scenes.title: New invitation, optional consent
scenes.caption: A reused group requires joining again. Ben optional marketing checkbox starts unticked.

note: Modal screens were recaptured after their opening animation settled. The video is a captioned sequence, not a continuous screen recording.
